entities.name: Lurrus of the Dream-Den
entities.description: Female cat nightmare of Ikoria who dens in the Indatha lowlands and can appear and disappear at will.

entities.name: Indatha lowlands
entities.description: Region of Ikoria where Lurrus makes its den.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who stumbled upon Lurrus's lair while exploring.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Lurrus fought in defense of Ikoria.

events.summary: Vivien Reid stumbles upon Lurrus's lair and finds a litter of nightmare kittens.
events.quote: The planeswalker Vivien Reid stumbled upon its lair while exploring

events.summary: Lurrus appears from a wisp of smoke when Vivien tries to look closer at the kittens, and Vivien leaves.
events.quote: Lurrus appeared from a wisp of smoke

events.summary: Lurrus fights in defense of Ikoria during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Lurrus fought in defense of Ikoria during the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.quote: Lurrus makes its den in the Indatha lowlands
